subject: SIG intake — Aperture packet & evidence routing
messages:
From: Maya Trevino <maya.trevino@aperture.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aperture Systems Procurement <procurement@aperture.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG and SOC 2 request for Aperture evaluation

Hi Karthik,

Following up from last week's intro call — Aperture is running a shortened supplier assurance review as part of our POC procurement. Can you please provide the following by EOD Friday: 

- Current SOC 2 Type II report (most recent year) and scope statement
- Completed SIG questionnaire (we've attached our template) or an initial spreadsheet that maps Redwood controls to SIG/CCM rows
- High-level control mapping for data residency & KMS keys for customer data (we are particularly focused on private deployment options)

We'd like to understand who on your team will own evidence collection and a realistic timeline for completion. If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute intake call to agree on owners and milestones.

Attaching: Aperture_SIG_Request_20270524.pdf (contains our internal intake fields & top-10 priority controls).

Thanks,
Maya Trevino
Senior Procurement Manager
Aperture Systems
maya.trevino@aperture.com

1) Intake call (20–30m) to assign owners and confirm gaps 
   - Proposed: Tue 25 May 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 26 May 09:30–10:00 PT
2) Deliverables by Fri 28 May: SOC 2 PDF + initial SIG workbook (completed columns A-D)
3) Follow-up week of Jun 7 for any supplemental artifacts and mapping refinement

Owner commitments (high-level):
- SOC 2 report & scope: Ben Carter (assurance lead)
- SIG workbook population & control mapping: Jasmine Liu (security engineering)
- Data residency / KMS details & architecture notes: Marissa Cole (product infra)
- Contract/security escalations: Karthik Iyer (sales lead)

I attached a short mutual action plan to capture milestones and who brings what. If that works, let's lock the intake call and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Aperture SIG intake — owners and short timeline

Team — forwarding Aperture's intake (see attached) and our proposed MAP. Quick ask: can each of you confirm the artifacts you can deliver by Fri 28 May? Prefer succinct status updates in-line.

Ben — SOC 2 PDF + SOC 2 bridge (if any scope exclusions)
Jasmine — populate SIG workbook columns A-D, add notes where we need clarifications; call out any controls we expect to answer via architectural diagrams or runbooks
Marissa — prepare a short data residency appendix (1 page) that calls out: region coverage, VPC/private deployment options, KMS/HSM flow, encryption at rest/in transit summary
Priyom — I'm looping you for legal/product redline notes and if we should pre-send any contractual language w.r.t. storage scope or customer-managed keys

Proposed deliverable checklist (short):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (final)
- SIG_Complete_Response_v1.xlsx (initial pass)
- Control_Mapping_Aperture.xlsx (two-column mapping: Aperture item -> Redwood artifact/location)
- Data_Residency_Appendix.pdf (1pg)

If anything will slip, flag now so I can push expectations with Aperture. I'll ship the calendar invite for Wed 26 May 09:30 PT (tentative).

Cheers,
Karthik

--
Note: internal coordination only. No external recipients on this message.

From: Maya Trevino <maya.trevino@aperture.com>

Thanks Karthik — Wed 26 May 09:30 PT works; invite received.

Attaching the Aperture SIG workbook (we pre-populated the first tab with our top 12 priority rows and added notes where we expect evidence). A couple of clarifying asks ahead of the call so we can triage quickly: 

- For controls referencing key management, can you indicate if Redwood supports customer-managed keys in Private deployment (Y/N) and whether HSM-backed KMS is available?
- We have a few questions under "Access Control" that will likely require a short diagram showing how admin/ops access is restricted for on-prem vs hosted variants.
- Please confirm any subprocessor list and data retention defaults (we asked that in the intake PDF).

Attachments: SIG_Questionnaire_Aperture_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 210 KB)

Look forward to speaking,
Maya

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Trevino <maya.trevino@aperture.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — Aperture packet & evidence routing

Maya — great call earlier this morning. Following up with the artifacts we agreed to deliver by EOD today and next steps. Attached items are the initial packet; we will populate follow-up items next week as discussed.

Delivered now (attachments):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf -> full report & scope statement
- SIG_Complete_Response_v1.xlsx -> SIG workbook, columns A–D completed, comments added on rows needing architectural diagrams
- Control_Mapping_Aperture.xlsx -> two-column mapping to help your intake team route evidence requests

Short answers to your earlier clarifying asks:
- Customer-managed keys (Private deployment): yes, we support customer-managed keys in Private VPC installs and can integrate with customer KMS/HSM. For hosted customers we offer a managed KMS and an enterprise option for bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via supported KMS providers; will include specific supported providers in the data residency appendix.
- Admin/ops access: Jasmine will send the on-prem vs hosted admin access diagram next week; for now, the SIG workbook flags rows that require that artifact.
- Subprocessors & retention: control mapping spreadsheet links to our subprocessors list (see column E) and retention defaults; legal (Priyom) will follow up on any contract language asks.

Next milestones:
- Week of Jun 7: Jasmine to deliver diagrams + any runbook extracts (if required)
- Week of Jun 14: Ben to provide any evidence bundles for audit traces requested in SIG rows 7–12

If you need anything faster, ping me or Ben directly.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
